mcp.guardTitle: Stop agents freelancing in the shell
mcp.guardHelp: Claude Code can run shell commands that go around this app's MCP tools. With this on, a guard (a PreToolUse hook for its Bash tool) refuses the usual routes: runpodctl, direct calls to RunPod's API, the pod CLI's create, resume and delete, changes to the BH bucket, and writes into Binc's mirror, and tells the agent which tool to use instead. It is a pattern check, not a sandbox. It applies to Claude Code for the current user on this Mac. A system-wide setting, with the agent rules; it travels in the configuration export.
